inputs.checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
inputs.question: On the landscape plan, are there any trees or vegetation shown within 10 feet of any transformer pad locations? If so, are these trees identified as utility-compatible species?
inputs.regionHint: Look for landscaping elements near the transformer pad locations shown on the electrical plan

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence question first (are there trees within 10 feet of transformer pads?) before any measurement or species verification. This is progressive verification—identifying whether trees exist in the relevant zone precedes the measurement and species-compatibility check that would follow.
